keep.quote: And the only wish you'd have marked down for spelling is the only one a person typed. Your father. Eight months out on a cargo ship. Three words, one wrong. Same as always.
Nobody can buy what nobody can see. The flaw in the power is the lock on it.
Nobody wrote it. Both of you meant it. Phones face down. Nothing to dot. Now you have to talk. Harder than it looks.
